name: the edits path is not recognised
why: Without _MB_POP_EDITS_RE in _mbPopParsePath() no /…/edits link is a target, and a sidebar 'Editing history' link has no card.

edits.find: if (h) return { seg: '', type: 'edits', id: h[1] ? `${h[1]}/${h[2].toLowerCase()}` : `user/${h[3]}` };

name: the button shows on every window
why: The button must follow _mbEditsSubject(): an ISRC, an edit or the history itself has no editing history.

name: an editor has no subject
why: The editor window's history is /user/<name>/edits; without the user branch the Editor card has no button.

name: H does nothing
why: H opens the history from the keyboard (the user's answer 2).

name: a keyboard click that repaints closes the window
why: createInfoDialog()'s outside-click check ran contains() on a target the repaint had detached; only a mouse click's mousedown flag hid it. composedPath() still names the dialog. The history's ↓ selects by a click.

name: an edit relationship's rowspan pair is two rows
why: th[rowspan=2] puts the old value on one row and the new on the next; without the pending pair the new value is a label-less row of its own.

name: an Old/New table is not split
why: An edit medium's tracklist is one value holding 'Old tracklist | New tracklist'; split, its halves are the OLD and NEW columns.

name: MusicBrainz's Note is hidden by 'Only what changed'
why: A Note row explains the edit (subsecond track lengths); it stays visible.

name: a nested table keeps the class tbl
why: Every global table.tbl query of the script would count the window's merge and tracklist tables.

name: the noscript thumbnail is dropped
why: An artwork cell's image is inside <noscript>; a DOMParser document parses it as markup, and without it the edit shows no cover and the viewer has nothing.

name: an open edit's page is kept
why: An open edit's votes change: a page holding one stays in memory only, as an open edit's card.

name: the browser check is just 'not the page expected'
why: MusicBrainz's 'Verifying your browser' page must be named, so the user knows to open the page once.

edits.find: return { ok: false, detail: _mbIsBrowserCheck(raw.html) ? _MB_BROWSER_CHECK_NOTE : 'not the page expected' };
edits.replace: return { ok: false, detail: 'not the page expected' };

name: nested batch members are not deduped
why: Another userscript nests batch members inside a summary div.edit-list on the LIVE page (debug/edits-*.html). The window parses FETCHED pages, which never carry that markup, so no fixture can see this guard; it is kept for the snapshots and recorded here as unseen.
